subject: Rename redisObject to serverObject (#175)
reason: The change is a pure compile-time refactor: it renames the C struct tag redisObject to serverObject (and forward declarations of it in rio.h and module.c, plus one comment in evict.c), updating the `typedef struct serverObject robj` alias in server.h in the same commit. The struct's fields, layout and every function signature are unchanged; a struct tag name has no runtime representation, so no command reply, persistence format, replication, module ABI or memory behavior can differ between the builds. There is no behavior change for a scenario to exercise.
